slides.title: From magazine to magazine in six steps

steps.b: The SLD250 magazine loader feeds the board; the S7900VI conveyor clamps it in position.
Tube, bulk belt, radial tape, axial tape and reel-terminal feeders present each part.
The head picks the part with a vacuum nozzle or a mechanical gripper.
Six industrial cameras capture the leads simultaneously in 0.5 s.
The head follows the programmed X-Y-Z path and inserts with controlled force and depth; the clinch unit bends the leads under the board.
The finished board goes to the SLUD250 magazine unloader.

slides.title: Clinched leads stop parts floating in wave soldering
bullets: Clinch units for U-shaped resistors, pins, USB, capacitors, inductors, connectors, transformers and PCB modules.
Four bend types: outward, inner, circular and 2 turns.
Bend angle 15–30° where an angle is specified.
Lead diameter below 1.0 mm and protruding lead at least 2 mm (final design decides).
Each clinched point adds about 2 s to the cycle.
